mapper.insert: INSERT INTO webdav_share_entry(job_id,song_id,relative_path,file_size,result_json,filename_json) SELECT #{id},s.id,s.relative_path,s.file_size,COALESCE(f.result_json,r.result_json),s.result_json FROM media_song s JOIN media_source source ON source.id=s.source_id LEFT JOIN webdav_resource r ON r.song_id=s.id LEFT JOIN media_metadata_file f ON f.song_id=s.id AND f.revision=f.synced_revision AND f.source_location=source.location WHERE s.source_id=#{sourceId}
mapper.update: UPDATE webdav_share_job SET total_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM webdav_share_entry WHERE job_id=#{id}) WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE webdav_share_job SET total_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_song WHERE source_id=#{sourceId}) WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM webdav_share_entry WHERE job_id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM webdav_share_job WHERE id=#{id} AND source_id=#{sourceId}
SELECT * FROM webdav_share_job WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM webdav_share_job WHERE state IN ('WAITING','QUEUED','RUNNING') ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 8

SELECT e.* FROM webdav_share_entry e WHERE e.job_id=#{id} AND e.song_id>#{cursor} AND (#{baseId} IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM webdav_share_entry old WHERE old.job_id=#{baseId} AND old.song_id=e.song_id AND old.relative_path=e.relative_path AND COALESCE(old.file_size,-1)=COALESCE(e.file_size,-1) AND COALESCE(old.result_json,'')=COALESCE(e.result_json,'') AND old.filename_json=e.filename_json)) ORDER BY e.song_id LIMIT 50
SELECT * FROM webdav_share_entry WHERE job_id=#{baseId} AND song_id=#{songId}

SELECT e.song_id,e.relative_path FROM webdav_share_entry e WHERE e.job_id=#{baseId} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM webdav_share_entry n WHERE n.job_id=#{id} AND n.song_id=e.song_id) AND e.song_id>#{cursor} ORDER BY e.song_id LIMIT 1000
SELECT hash FROM webdav_share_asset WHERE job_id=#{id} AND hash=#{hash}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO webdav_share_asset(job_id,hash) SELECT #{id},#{hash} WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM webdav_share_asset WHERE job_id=#{id} AND hash=#{hash})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM webdav_share_receipt WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} AND binding=#{binding} AND hash=#{hash}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO webdav_share_receipt(source_id,binding,hash) SELECT #{sourceId},#{binding},#{hash} WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM webdav_share_receipt WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} AND binding=#{binding} AND hash=#{hash})
mapper.update: UPDATE webdav_share_receipt SET processed=#{processed},imported=#{imported},skipped=#{skipped} WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} AND binding=#{binding} AND hash=#{hash}
UPDATE webdav_share_lock SET id=id WHERE id=1
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM webdav_share_job WHERE (#{sourceId} IS NULL OR source_id=#{sourceId}) AND state IN ('WAITING','QUEUED','RUNNING')

SELECT id FROM webdav_share_job old WHERE old.created_at<#{before} AND old.state IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM webdav_share_job active WHERE active.base_id=old.id AND active.state IN ('WAITING','QUEUED','RUNNING')) LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE webdav_share_receipt SET processed=processed WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} AND binding=#{binding} AND hash=#{hash}
